svg.title: FolioRecall: offline page indexing and online query retrieval
svg.desc: Paper-style system overview. Offline, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B encodes document pages into normalized 2048-dimensional vectors saved in a FAISS index. Online, the public NanoVDR ML student encodes raw English queries into the compatible space; CPU inner-product search returns ranked pages and JSON. Preview files are separate from the index. Page drawings and vector cells are schematic, not measured examples. Teacher and index identity are checked at startup.
svg.text: Encode each query · public ML student
